goal: Implement Auto Trader Pro Institutional Frontend UI & Session Scheduler: 5-Level Zero-Emoji Visual Hierarchy, Dedicated Master View, Dashboard Widget, Daily Guardrails (+3% Target, -2% Loss, Max Trades), and Real Demo Balance Accounting

contracts.interfaces: export interface AutoTraderSessionConfig { allocatedCapital: number; sessionDurationMinutes: number; dailyTargetProfitPct: number; dailyMaxLossPct: number; maxTradesPerDay: number; tradingProfile: 'MOMENTUM_INTRADAY' | 'FAST_SCALP' | 'SCALP' | 'SWING'; }

execution_steps: Write unit tests in frontend/src/__tests__/auto_trader_session_ui.test.js covering session scheduler, daily guardrails, and real demo balance debit/credit flow
Run node --test to verify red phase
Update autoTraderRunner.ts to support session scheduling, daily target profit, daily max loss, and trade limits
Create frontend/src/components/dashboard/AutoTraderDashboardWidget.tsx with vectorial SVG icons and zero emojis
Create frontend/src/components/AutoTraderView.tsx with 5-level institutional hierarchy, capital/duration pills, active trade radar, Break-Even SVG lock, Trailing Stop line, and MFE/MAE telemetry
Update BottomNavMobile.tsx and App.tsx to register AUTOTRADER in MasterViewType and render AutoTraderView
Update DashboardView.tsx to embed AutoTraderDashboardWidget in the top hero area
Run node --test to verify green phase
Run full regression test suites across auto trader modules
Run npm run build --prefix frontend and npx oxlint to guarantee zero errors and zero warnings
acceptance_criteria: Dedicated AUTOTRADER master view is accessible from navigation in both desktop and mobile
AutoTraderDashboardWidget is rendered in DashboardView providing quick glance of status and CTA link
Zero emojis are used anywhere in the UI; only professional SVG icons (Phosphor / Lucide) are rendered
Capital selection allows $10, $100, $1,000, and custom amounts with validation against available demo balance
Session duration selector allows 30m, 1h, 2h, 3h, 4h, 5h, 8h, 12h, 24h, and continuous
Guardrails support configurable daily profit target (+3%), daily max loss shield (-2%), and max trades ceiling (3-5)
Active trade card displays Break-Even lock state, Trailing Stop dynamic level, and MFE/MAE metrics
Demo balance debits on trade allocation and credits principal plus net profit/loss upon exit
All unit tests pass with exit code 0 and build finishes with 0 errors
definition_of_done: No pre-existing bots, portfolios, or views are broken or regressed
